consumer: The GUI tile-draw/cata_tiles render path asking 'should this tile be drawn with the dimmed remembered-but-not-currently-visible shading?'
scope: Per-tile display state distinguishing currently-visible vs remembered-from-avatar-memory vs never-seen, driven by the avatar's memorized-tile map
decisive_source: map::pl_sees (src/map.cpp) returns a raw line-of-sight visibility predicate: whether the player can SEE the tile right now within radius; it does not consult the avatar's tile memory
divergence: A tile the avatar explored earlier and stored in memory, now out of sight behind a wall: pl_sees returns false identically to a never-seen tile, so the boolean cannot drive the dimmed-remembered shading the GUI shows for it
